note: Regional park on the south edge of Montmartre, three blocks from the village's shops. Mostly seasonal: 36 of its 52 serviced sites are seasonal; 16 are sold by the night, plus a non-serviced overflow field and a tent area. Heated outdoor pool with waterslide and spray park, disc golf, ball diamonds, trails; a nine-hole sand-greens golf course 0.8 km east. Utilities sit at the back of the newer sites, so bring an extra-long cord, hose and sewer connector. --Claude
